name: Opus 5.5
tune: Brahms' Lullaby, with a bass line

notes.label: Ambition
notes.text: The most ambitious machine: a glowing brass lantern with a screw lift, eleven gated tracks and dust in the light.

notes.label: Motion
notes.text: Marbles really circulate: lifted, queued, released, then they swirl down the bowl and get lifted again.

notes.label: Clarity
notes.text: So much is moving that it's hard to see which marble played which note. Struck bars flare almost white.

notes.label: Sound
notes.text: A warm bell tone with a bass line, but the rhythm drifts and stray ticks blur the tune.

name: Fable 5.2
tune: Frère Jacques, as a four-voice round

notes.label: Idea
notes.text: The cleverest musical idea: the spiral of 32 bars is the score, and four marbles play it as a round.

notes.label: Clarity
notes.text: Easy to follow. Each marble has its own colour, and the bar it hits glows in that colour.

notes.label: Sound
notes.text: Every note lands in tune and on time. The round thins out and rebuilds, so the loop never feels like a restart.

notes.label: Looks
notes.text: Clean and calm, but a little plain: the machine sits small in the frame and the marbles read as plastic, not glass.
